shortDescription: Node-level firewall options management for Proxmox VE cluster

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: log_level_forward
options.description: Log level for fowarded traffic.

options.name: log_level_in
options.description: Log level for incoming traffic.

options.name: log_level_out
options.description: Log level for outgoing traffic.

options.name: ndp
options.description: Enable NDP (Neighbor Discovery Protocol).

options.name: nf_conntrack_allow_invalid
options.description: Allow invalid packets on connection tracking.

options.name: nf_conntrack_helpers
options.description: Enable conntrack helpers for specific protocols.

options.name: nf_conntrack_max
options.description: Maximum number of tracked connections. Minimum value is 32768.

options.name: nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established
options.description: Conntrack established timeout in seconds. Minimum value is 7875.

options.name: nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_syn_recv
options.displayName: Nf Conntrack Tcp Timeout Syn Recv
options.description: Conntrack syn receive timeout. Values between 30 - 60.

options.name: nftables
options.description: Enable nftables based firewall.

options.name: node_name
options.description: Name of the node to configure the firewall on.

options.name: nosmurfs
options.description: Enable SMURFS filter.

options.name: protection_synflood
options.description: Enable synflood protection.

options.name: protection_synflood_burst
options.description: Synflood protection rate burst by IP source address.

options.name: protection_synflood_rate
options.description: Synflood protection rate syn/sec by IP source address.

options.name: smurf_log_level
options.description: Log level for SMURFS filter.

options.name: state
options.description: Enable or disable the firewall node-wide.

options.name: tcp_flags_log_level
options.description: Log level for illegal TCP flags filter.

options.name: tcpflags
options.description: Filter illegal combinations of TCP flags.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).
